meta.name: sandbox-stable
meta.description: Build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps on the stable @cloudflare/sandbox package. Use sandbox-next for preview apps and sandbox-migrate-to-next for stable-to-preview migrations.

copy.tagline: 维护 Cloudflare 沙盒应用稳定版并迁移到预览版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 Cloudflare 沙盒开发且需要切换或升级版本
copy.tagline_en: Maintain stable Cloudflare sandbox apps and migrate them to preview
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop in Cloudflare sandbox and need to switch or upgrade versions

howto.what: 当你要用 Cloudflare Sandbox 稳定版(@cloudflare/sandbox)构建或维护应用时,Claude 会先核对项目用的是稳定版还是预览版,再按官方规范写沙箱模式下的命令、会话、文件等代码,并按任务打开对应的官方文档参考。
howto.when: 当你要求构建或维护 Sandbox 应用,且项目使用的是默认的 @cloudflare/sandbox(不带 @next 标签)时;若检查发现是 @next 预览版,技能会停止并转交。

say.text: 帮我创建一个使用 stable 包、在沙箱里跑 Python 的 Worker
检查我这个 Sandbox 项目用的是稳定版还是 preview
say.note: Claude 会检查 npm 依赖和容器镜像标签后给出判断。

say.text: 我想在沙箱里执行 ls 并读取输出

howto.what_en: When you build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps on the stable @cloudflare/sandbox package, Claude first verifies whether the project uses the stable or preview package, then writes sandbox commands, sessions, files, etc. per the official API, and opens the matching Cloudflare docs for the task.
howto.when_en: This triggers when you ask to build or maintain a Sandbox app and the project uses the default @cloudflare/sandbox (not an @next tag). If inspection shows the @next preview package, the skill stops and hands off.

say_en.text: Create a Worker using the stable package that runs Python in the sandbox.
say_en.note: Claude generates code with stable APIs and consults the docs.

say_en.text: Check whether my Sandbox project uses stable or preview.
say_en.note: Claude inspects the npm dependency and image tag.

say_en.text: Run ls in the sandbox and show me the output.
say_en.note: Claude writes exec code and shows stdout/exitCode.
